metadata.gpu_hours: about 1.0 (one RTX 4090: vLLM sessions about 0.45 h incl. server start-ups, HF scoring about 0.4 h, plus model loads)

deviations.text: The plan's new forced paraphrase 'Solve this task with {j}.' is verbatim exp1 forced template 3, so it was replaced by 'Apply {j} to solve this task.' to keep 10 distinct paraphrases.
